verdict.rationale: A state agency that runs online employer tax and wage filing could plausibly publish a developer API, so the axis applies. However, no evidence shows any API reference, let alone an interactive one with runnable examples. Probes of common OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404, and the transactional portal sits behind a SecureAccess Washington login wall; the documentation covers only web-portal, video, PDF and paper filing workflows.
